events.name: Peter Hook & The Light
events.info: All sales final. No Refunds. General Admission. Standing Room Only. Peter Hook & the Light: Performing Joy Division's 'Unknown Pleasures' and 'Closer' Live Peter Hook first revisited the seminal Joy Division album Unknown Pleasures back in May 2010 for a commemorative charity concert and has followed it each year by performing subsequent albums from the repertoire of his bands, Joy Division and New Order. That dedication to his back catalogue has now seen him move through Unknown Pleasures, Closer, Still, Movement, Power Corruption & Lies, Low Life, Brotherhood, Technique, Republic, the Substance albums and Get Ready. Having toured each album extensively, the band have now amassed approaching 1000 concerts.

events.name: SEU Worship: The Found In The Field Tour - Birmingham, AL
events.info: After a sold-out summer tour, SEU Worship is back and hitting the road this fall and spring for The Found In The Field Tour! Born out of the worship movement at Southeastern University, SEU Worship is bringing their signature sound and honest, faith-filled lyrics to 8 cities across the country for nights of music, community, and worship. Following the momentum of their first headlining tour, this next chapter is an invitation to go deeper, gather with friends, encounter Jesus, and be reminded of what it means to be found in His presence. Join SEU Worship for powerful worship, authentic community, and a fresh reminder that we are never too far from the One who is always searching for us.
